pages.text: It was evening. The stream was calm. Dad threw a stone. Hop, hop, hop! It bounced three times on the water.
"Wow! I want a stone to bounce too." Mumu looked around the stony shore.
Dodo picked up a stone. "Round stones bounce well, like balls. I know! Just like marbles!"
She threw a fist-sized round stone hard.
Splash! A column of water shot up. Dodo was soaked right to the top of her head.
"...That was diving practice," she said, dripping.
Mumu looked at Dad. His wing held a flat, smooth stone.
Mumu chose a flat stone too and threw it low, skimming the water.
Hop, hop! It bounced twice. "It bounced!"
Then a frog hopped onto Dodo's round stone, sunk by the shore. "That frog must have bought my stone as a chair!" The frog answered with one more croak.
